test.excerpt: The maps below show the village of Hillmoor in 1995 and in 2025. Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and…

document.lead: You should spend about 20 minutes on this task.

chart.alt: Two maps of Hillmoor village, 1995 (top) and 2025 (bottom); north is at the top. A main road runs west to east through the middle. 1995: north of the road — farmland in the west, a church in the centre and a village shop to its east; south of the road — a primary school in the south-west, a row of houses in the centre and woodland in the south-east. 2025: the farmland has been replaced by a housing estate; the church is unchanged; the village shop is now a café, with a new bus stop on the main road in front of it; a new sports hall stands south of the primary school; the houses are unchanged; about two thirds of the woodland has been replaced by a supermarket and its car park, leaving a narrow strip of trees on the eastern edge.
